why: Classic in the catalogue drifts from the arrays the game draws (issue #1056). The palette holds IDENTITY_RING_COLORS by reference so that a player who picks "Classic" is given the shipped look by construction; a copy can be edited apart from it, as here, where ring 3 is one level off. The literal pin of IDENTITY_RING_COLORS still passes because the shipped array did not move, so only the identity half of the test (toBe, not toEqual) catches it.
killedBy: owner palettes: the catalogue (issue #1056) Classic is the shipped seven hexes, written out, and the very arrays every consumer reads
